associations.rationale: TensorProductDef is the declaration that defines the tensor-product type from k-modules V and W, so it is the definition-level declaration corresponding to the source construction of V ⊗ W.
The add_tmul law records additivity of pure tensors in the first variable. It supplies one defining relation of the quotient presentation but does not itself define the tensor-product type.
The smul_tmul law moves a scalar from the first tensor factor to the tensor product. It supports one scalar relation in the quotient presentation but does not itself define V ⊗ W.

tmul constructs the pure tensor represented by a pair (v, w). It is a constructor used to express the symbols and relations in the source definition, not the declaration defining the tensor-product type itself.
The tmul_add law records additivity of pure tensors in the second variable. It supplies one defining relation of the quotient presentation but does not itself define the tensor-product type.
The tmul_smul law moves a scalar from the second tensor factor to the tensor product. It supports the other scalar-moving relation in the quotient presentation but does not itself define V ⊗ W.
